governing_spec: Cloud addendum (Part B brief unavailable in this cloud session; stage structure reconstructed from the addendum and prior-work branches). Ambiguities go to HUMAN_QUEUE.md, not guessed.

environment.network: restricted proxy: pypi/apt/github reachable; loc.gov, tile.loc.gov, maps.lib.utexas.edu, texashistory.unt.edu blocked (CONNECT 403)
environment.source_fetch_path: GitHub Actions CI runners (full egress) commit sources to data branches; sessions read them via git
environment.toolchain: libvips-dev libvips-tools gdal-bin libgdal-dev + pyvips rasterio rio-cogeo opencv-python-headless scikit-image shapely geopandas pillow numpy requests matplotlib (pip --ignore-installed over debian numpy)

1912_pipeline.state: complete through acceptance: 00_inventory..90_decisions, solved per-sheet affine transforms (40_solve/output/transforms.json, gauge = sheet 10 identity), seam cuts/masks (50_seams), QA run1, two reviewer reports + ACCEPTANCE.md, deliverable 27x40 PDF

1912_sources.state: 129 files from LOC sanborn08539_004 with inventory.json (URL+sha256 each); 18 archival JP2s cover the target sheets

1899_sources.state: 102 files from UT PCL with SHA256SUMS + INDEX_LINKS.txt; sheets 01-94 + skeletons + key/index/cover

1899_pipeline.state: print tooling (make_print.py, layout-index.json with 0.67-row wharf offset, 5%-per-side overlap inset); NO solved per-sheet transforms — placement is grid-cell, verified by reading street numbers, not by control-point solve

0_inventory.notes: Built from committed provenance; sha256 spot-checked against git blobs (6/6 pass). No network used.

1_consolidate_1912.plan: Port frozen 1912 solve into recipe form: transforms.json (verbatim + convention note), seam cuts/masks, adjacency, plate structure, QC scores from 70_qa/run1 seam_matrix, provenance manifest referencing FREEZE_MANIFEST hashes.

2_register_1899.plan: True registration for the 13 print sheets: half-resolution working copies, control points at street junctions read from printed street names/numbers (correlation alone is defeated by the ~820 px block pitch — see g5pfqc README), solve per-sheet affines with a gauge sheet, seam polygons. This is the heavy stage; use up to 4 agents on contiguous groups.

3_qc.plan: Seam QC crops from full-res overlap margins for both years; worst-ten seams to STATUS.md; open items to HUMAN_QUEUE.md with PNGs under outputs/qc/human/.

4_tools_indexes.plan: sheets/blocks/intersections.geojson per year; tools/render.py (byte-for-byte, disk estimate printed up front); tools/crop.py (address + print size, lazy hash-cached fetch via git mirrors first, source URLs second); REPORT.md; DZI only if <500MB/year.

disk.policy: one year of full sheets on disk at a time; working copies at half resolution; delete after stage passes and is pushed
